idea-plugin.name: WildFly Community Runner
idea-plugin.description:
Run and debug local WildFly applications from your IDE.

WildFly Community Runner brings standalone server controls and multi-service deployment to IntelliJ IDEA Community and compatible IntelliJ IDEA releases.

  • Use native Run, Debug, and Attach configurations with configurable debug ports.
  • Discover nested Maven and Gradle services; build and deploy several selections in sequence.
  • Redeploy when a final WAR, EAR, or JAR changes. Source edits alone never trigger Auto Redeploy.
  • Share server profiles and remembered service sources across open projects.
  • Keep external deployments separate and inspect status, deployment time, and server.log.
  • Store sensitive JVM properties in the IDE password store or reference environment variables.

Requires a local WildFly installation in standalone mode. No server download or automatic build occurs on first use. Domain mode and remote deployment management are not supported.

Getting started · Troubleshooting · Report an issue

Independent community project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Red Hat or JetBrains.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
0.6.0

  • Native server Run/Debug and Attach configurations, with shared process ownership.
  • Background onboarding, improved process detection, cancellable build batches, and hardened artifact watches.
  • Versioned settings migration, remembered-source cleanup, and secure JVM-property references.
  • Bounded live server.log viewer with rotation recovery, pause, filtering, and editor access.
  • Automated regression tests, real-runtime smoke tests, and compatibility checks across six IDE builds.
